d: India’s apex food safety regulator, the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI), on Monday (November 22) announced enforcement action against nine entities — including ‘sanction of prosecution’ for India’s largest bottled water manufacturer, Bisleri. ‘Sanction of prosecution’, under Section 42 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, refers to the official approval required from the Commissioner of Food Safety before criminal legal proceedings can be launched against an offender.
